name: player_apply_terrain_tilt
description: Player::ApplyTerrainTilt applies terrain-normal tilt impulses to pitch/roll velocity and adds gravity-scaled steering-reference impulse to projectile velocity.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so in-place Vec3RotateY behavior, x87 clamp comparisons, and terrain caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42c8d0 validates tilt scaling by nominal/current gravity and caller scale, yaw rotation by -restartYawRad, airborne landing reset call, pitch/roll angular velocity accumulation and +/-1.2 clamp, and projectile velocity impulse from steerBasisRef X/Z scaled by delta time, gravity, and 5.
The native smoke verifies the terrain tilt clamp and projectile velocity impulse path, with the landing reset behavior covered by the same helper smoke.
